title: unified-rollouts-add-probing-canary-shadow-ab-autorollback-workflow
author: Asha Patel
description: Add probing staged workflow that wires together canary, A/B, and shadow traffic modes with automatic rollback on composite-probing metrics. This PR implements the controller and the policy engine hooks needed to run a probing stage before increasing traffic share, adds metric quorum logic for composite signals, exposes new telemetry for rollout decision tracing, and includes an end-to-end integration test and docs. Motivation: we observed two incidents where a model variant passed single-metric checks but regressed on downstream latency and semantic-quality signals when traffic increased. Probing stages allow low-volume synthetic and live probes to validate composite signals (latency, error-rate, semantic drift) before traffic ramp. Scope in this PR: 1) rollout controller changes: probing stage state machine, new rollout stages (probe -> canary -> shadow -> scale), safety timeouts, and quarantine path; 2) policy engine: composite metric definition, quorum window, and threshold semantics; 3) observability: rollout_decision_trace span, per-stage histograms, and metric labels for probe vs live traffic; 4) e2e tests: simulated probing signals and automated rollback assertion; 5) docs: rollout workflow guide and example policy YAML. This description includes implementation notes, test plan, and rollout guidance.
commits: Initial probing-stage state machine and CRD updates
Policy engine composite-metric and quorum window
E2E: probing-stage integration test and fake metrics harness
Docs: rollout guide and example policy YAML
Fix: handle missing metric labels in telemetry path

review_comments: Jonah Li: Nice separation of concerns in the state machine. A few nits: prefer context-aware timeouts on the probe step and ensure cancellation of inflight probes.
María Gómez: Can we avoid introducing a new histogram cardinality dimension for every rollout id? Consider using rollout_type label and aggregate by window.
Evan Brooks: Tests look good. One request: add a failure-mode test where probe metrics are missing to validate quarantine path.

Asha Patel (author): Addressed Jonah's timeout and cancellation comments in commit 3. Maria's histogram cardinality change adjusted by using rollout_type label in commit 4. Added quarantine missing-metrics test per Evan in commit 5.
author_responses: Thanks all — pushed fixes for timeouts and histogram labels. Added quarantine path unit test and e2e verification for rollback behavior.
ci_logs_summary: Initial run: unit-tests pass, integration-tests failed on metric label expectation (fixed)
Second run: all checks green, e2e-rollouts exercised probing flow and rollback assertion
release_notes: Adds probing staged rollout workflow that performs low-volume probe validation using composite metrics before increasing traffic share. Includes new telemetry for rollout decision tracing and safety/quarantine paths.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: new stage increases controller complexity and adds telemetry cardinality. Mitigation: feature gated behind rollout.experimental.probing flag, limited rollout to Dedicated clusters for two weeks, and metric cardinality reduced by using rollout_type label instead of rollout_id.
test_plan: Unit tests for state transitions and policy logic, e2e integration that simulates probe signals and validates autorollback on composite metric failure, manual smoke test steps in docs for canary on staging.
